resources.string: Remove connected profiles and active sessions first. Deletion is blocked during installation, management, or legacy adoption, or when the runtime cannot be verified stopped.

Permanently delete execution environment %1$s and its installed distribution? The distribution image, installation cache, packages, home and settings will be deleted. Existing /workspace data and Shared Folders are preserved. Deleted environment data cannot be recovered.

Permanently delete execution environment %1$s and its Debian image? After verifying that the VM is stopped, the image, packages, home, settings, persistent VM state and file copies inside the VM will be deleted. Host Shared Folders are preserved. Deleted VM data cannot be recovered.
Manage execution environment names, storage, installation, and runtime state.
ARM64 PRoot engine · no additional Android permissions
The PRoot engine does not support this device architecture.
Custom Debian ARM64 VMs require AVF support and MANAGE_VIRTUAL_MACHINE and USE_CUSTOM_VIRTUAL_MACHINE permissions.

Delete this execution environment’s distribution image and the packages and files inside it. Home data and the working directory are preserved by default. The execution environment and its profiles remain available for reinstalling later. Deleted data cannot be recovered.

Delete this execution environment’s Debian image, including the VM’s home, installed packages, and configuration. The execution environment, its profiles, and shared-folder files remain available for reinstalling Debian later. Deleted data cannot be recovered.
Removal is blocked while sessions or installation/management tasks are active, or runtime safety cannot be verified.
